text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a new personal best on your deadlift!
Way to go, Ai!
You've been breaking records every session lately!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I suppose you could say she overcame a high wall and entered a growth spurt.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Blast, you're up next!
Shall we switch out the weight plates?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(............ I kind of talked a big game just now.
But the reason I'm growing is definitely—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...No good. I just can't seem to break past the wall of my personal best from a month ago. I thought my form was spot on, though.
choice_data_list: Maybe try lowering your hips just a tiny bit more?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
More?
I thought I had dropped it plenty already...
choice_data_list: Just try it once and see how it goes.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I-I did it...!
Personal best, plus 10 kg...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer. Would you mind watching my other events too—like the snatch?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, Blast. The reason my times
are improving...
might actually be surprisingly simple.”

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What?
Tell me, tell me! Boo wants to know too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: One thing I can say is—fufu.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Having someone you can rely on close by.
Something like that, I suppose.
